events.summary: Darien fulfills his dream of unification and becomes the last king of Kjeldor.
events.quote: With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor.

events.summary: Liliana's betrayal of Bolas costs her nothing, to her surprise.
events.quote: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

events.summary: Ugin sees the gem connecting Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.
events.quote: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

events.summary: Vraska betrays Jace, whispering for the glory of Phyrexia as he hoped to save his love.
events.quote: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra, sent to learn of the past, uncover Terisiare's future at Tocasia's dig site.
events.quote: Urza and Mishra instead uncovered Terisiare's future.

events.summary: Jace finds the Drownyard Temple where all the cryptoliths point.
events.quote: This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!

relations.quote: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.
To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

relations.note: Vraska took advantage of Jace's moment of hope.
